negative_results.finding: The first production-like LALR proxy parsed false in rule RAE.CLAUDE.endturn_meta_research=false as a qid rather than BOOLEAN.
negative_results.impact: Semantic canonicalization would be wrong despite parse success.

negative_results.finding: The first proxy accepted keyword-like field identifiers such as status/dialect/version/requires through literal alternatives but emitted empty ident nodes, losing lexical identity in the parse tree.
negative_results.impact: Parse closure alone is insufficient for a canonical AST.

negative_results.finding: Whole-program Earley dynamic_complete ambiguity execution exceeded the local sandbox resource envelope and was terminated.
negative_results.repair: Switched to brace-balanced top-level ambiguity checks over the same 86 G9 plus 25 Dialect units.

causes: false matching both BOOLEAN and NAME/qid

repair_candidate.mechanism: Reserve declaration/operator keywords and booleans out of NAME; represent keyword-like identifiers through explicit ident_<keyword> grammar aliases so their semantic names remain reconstructible; preserve BOOLEAN as its own token class.

interpretation: All three relation surfaces survive the stricter lexical-identity repair. D remains the local parse-time/migration leader but has the largest grammar and slowest median parser build. No surface is promoted until target-reader and normative compiler integration evidence exists.
